title: narcissus gaditanus var. minutiflorus
intro: Narcissus gaditanus var. minutiflorus, commonly known as the Canary Islands narcissus or tiny-flowered gaditanus, is a type of flowering bulbous perennial plant native to the Canary Islands. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, prevent cancer, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus gaditanus var. minutiflorus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, and to protect against neurodegenerative diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
